---
title: "10_Geparametrizeerde_Rmarkdown"
output: html_document
params:
  land: "Austria"
  jaar: 2022
  maand: 10
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
covid_data <- read_csv("~/Workflows/Workflows_Portfolio/Opdracht_9_CovidRmarkdown/data.csv")
```

```{r}

data_filter <- covid_data %>%
  filter(
    countriesAndTerritories == params$land,
    year == params$jaar,
    month == params$maand
  )
```


```{r}
ggplot(data_filter, aes(x = day, y = cases)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = paste("COVID-19 cases in", params$land),
    x = "Day",
    y = "Cases"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(data_filter, aes(x = day, y = deaths)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = paste("COVID-19 deaths in", params$land),
    x = "Day",
    y = "Deaths"
  )
```
